test_title: PYST 9: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I will require a quiet room to work __at__.
solution:
The correct answer is **in**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the preposition **"at"** with the verb **"work."**
 
• The correct preposition to use in this context is **"in,"** indicating the place where the work will take place.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"to work in."**
 
• Thus, the error is located in the prepositional phrase of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I will require a quiet room to work in__."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "with"** – This preposition does not fit the context of the sentence and would be grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 2: "about"** – This preposition does not fit the context of the sentence and would be grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 3: "on"** – This preposition is often used with tasks or projects but not with the place where work is done.
